subject: Reopened: re-review CHANGES REQUIRED (revocation on user_tx, ui_copy, tests) — decisions inside
body:
S03 re-review: CHANGES REQUIRED (5/7 prior items fixed). Reviewer worktree: /home/user/naadi/.claude/worktrees/rr03 (probe .tmp/test_rr03_probe.py). Lead decisions:
1. Session revocation on every user-data route: make user_tx require an account-checked user (AccountDirectory) so no route can skip it; switch courses' limited() and every other user_tx caller. db test: revoked session → 401 on a courses route (PUT reading-position, GET courses) within the cache window. Coordinate on the ledger with seg06/seg07/seg08 (their routes use user_tx) — you own auth_db.py, they rebase.
2. Playwright hosted-DB guard: owned by seg04 (holds playwright.config.ts), already assigned; lead escalated to HIGH. Not yours.
3. Move ALL remaining literal strings in AccountPage, SignInPage, TodayPage, AppShell (lines listed in the review) to required ui_copy keys + regenerated defaults; add 'routes' and 'shell' roots to apps/web/src/content/noHardcodedCopy.test.ts once seg06 lands it (or create the shared test if it hasn't landed — coordinate with seg06).
4. Google PKCE flow always tested: mock /api/public-config google_oauth_enabled:true. Run-once tests move to a dedicated project/testMatch so they never appear as skips.
5. Restore the three local-DB tests from tests/test_integration.py into a db module using require_local.
6. Phone tab bar truncation: owned by seg07 (same defect in S07 review). Not yours.
7. Add revocation tests for /api/admin/overview and agent.auth.authenticate (adopt the reviewer's probe).
Follow docs/REVIEW_CHECKLIST.md; local e2e = smoke set; full matrix from CI. E2E_PORT 7892 block.
